The note doesn't fit the constraints, so I'm keeping my original schedule.

If Cara were in slot 8 and Hana in slot 9, Ivo would have to be in slot 6, because exactly one person sits between Ivo and Cara and Ivo is before Cara. That leaves slots 1–5 and 7 for Ann, Dev, Finn, Ben, Elif and Gus. Slot 7 can't hold any of them:
- Dev is before Ivo, so Dev is in slot 5 or earlier.
- Ann is right after Dev and can't take Ivo's slot 6, so Ann is in slot 5 or earlier.
- Finn and Ben are before Dev, and Elif is before Ann, so all three are earlier still.
- Gus is right after Elif, and Elif must be at least three slots from Cara, so Elif is in slot 5 or earlier. Gus could only reach slot 7 if Elif were in slot 6, and that is Ivo's slot.

So six people would have to fit into five slots, which is impossible.

The only arrangement that satisfies every constraint puts Cara in slot 9 and Hana in slot 8. I checked it against each rule:
- Ben (2), Elif (3) and Gus (4) are consecutive, with one person between Ben and Gus.
- Ivo (7) and Cara (9) have one person between them, and Ivo is before Cara.
- Finn (1) is before Dev (5), Dev is before Ivo (7), and Ann (6) is right after Dev.
- Cara is 8 slots from Finn, 3 from Ann and 6 from Elif.
- Ann is 5 slots from Finn.
- Elif (3) is before Ann (6), Ann is before Hana (8), and Ben (2) is before Dev (5).

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Finn","2":"Ben","3":"Elif","4":"Gus","5":"Dev","6":"Ann","7":"Ivo","8":"Hana","9":"Cara"}
CONFIDENCE: 97
